mapper.sql: waitlist.id, waitlist.schedule_slot_id, waitlist.status, waitlist.offer_expire_time, waitlist.created_at, waitlist.updated_at, doctor.name AS doctor_name, department.name AS department_name, slot.schedule_date, slot.session_name, slot.start_time, slot.end_time
mapper.select: SELECT id, patient_id, schedule_slot_id, status, offer_expire_time, created_at, updated_at FROM appointment_waitlist WHERE schedule_slot_id = #{scheduleSlotId} AND status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT waitlist.id, waitlist.patient_id, waitlist.schedule_slot_id, waitlist.status, waitlist.offer_expire_time, waitlist.created_at, waitlist.updated_at FROM appointment_waitlist waitlist INNER JOIN doctor_schedule_slot slot ON slot.id = waitlist.schedule_slot_id WHERE waitlist.status = 'WAITING' AND ( slot.schedule_date < DATE(#{now}) OR (slot.schedule_date = DATE(#{now}) AND slot.end_time <= TIME(#{now})) ) ORDER BY slot.schedule_date ASC, slot.end_time ASC, waitlist.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment_waitlist waitlist INNER JOIN doctor_schedule_slot slot ON slot.id = waitlist.schedule_slot_id SET waitlist.status = 'EXPIRED', waitlist.offer_expire_time = NULL WHERE waitlist.id = #{waitlistId} AND waitlist.status = 'WAITING' AND ( slot.schedule_date < DATE(#{now}) OR (slot.schedule_date = DATE(#{now}) AND slot.end_time <= TIME(#{now})) )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM appointment_waitlist waitlist INNER JOIN doctor_schedule_slot slot ON slot.id = waitlist.schedule_slot_id INNER JOIN doctor ON doctor.id = slot.doctor_id INNER JOIN department ON department.id = doctor.department_id WHERE waitlist.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY waitlist.created_at DESC, waitlist.id DESC

SELECT FROM appointment_waitlist waitlist INNER JOIN doctor_schedule_slot slot ON slot.id = waitlist.schedule_slot_id INNER JOIN doctor ON doctor.id = slot.doctor_id INNER JOIN department ON department.id = doctor.department_id WHERE waitlist.id = #{id} AND waitlist.patient_id = #{patientId}
mapper.sql: waitlist.id, waitlist.patient_id, waitlist.schedule_slot_id, COALESCE(patient.real_name, account.name, account.username) AS patient_name, account.username, account.phone, department.id AS department_id, department.name AS department_name, doctor.id AS doctor_id, doctor.name AS doctor_name, slot.schedule_date, slot.session_name, slot.start_time, slot.end_time, waitlist.status, waitlist.created_at, waitlist.offer_expire_time, CASE WHEN waitlist.status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN waitlist.updated_at END AS confirmed_at, CASE WHEN waitlist.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN waitlist.updated_at END AS cancelled_at

FROM appointment_waitlist waitlist INNER JOIN patient ON patient.id = waitlist.patient_id INNER JOIN sys_user account ON account.id = patient.user_id INNER JOIN doctor_schedule_slot slot ON slot.id = waitlist.schedule_slot_id INNER JOIN doctor ON doctor.id = slot.doctor_id INNER JOIN department ON department.id = doctor.department_id
mapper.select: SELECT slot.id AS schedule_slot_id, department.name AS department_name, doctor.name AS doctor_name, slot.schedule_date, slot.session_name, slot.start_time, slot.end_time, slot.total_capacity, slot.remaining_capacity, SUM(CASE WHEN waitlist.status = 'WAITING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waiting_count FROM doctor_schedule_slot slot INNER JOIN doctor ON doctor.id = slot.doctor_id INNER JOIN department ON department.id = doctor.department_id LEFT JOIN appointment_waitlist waitlist ON waitlist.schedule_slot_id = slot.id WHERE slot.id = #{scheduleSlotId} GROUP BY slot.id, department.name, doctor.name, slot.schedule_date, slot.session_name, slot.start_time, slot.end_time, slot.total_capacity, slot.remaining_capacity

SELECT waitlist.id, waitlist.patient_id, COALESCE(patient.real_name, account.name, account.username) AS patient_name, account.username, account.phone, waitlist.status, waitlist.created_at, waitlist.offer_expire_time FROM appointment_waitlist waitlist INNER JOIN patient ON patient.id = waitlist.patient_id INNER JOIN sys_user account ON account.id = patient.user_id WHERE waitlist.schedule_slot_id = #{scheduleSlotId} AND waitlist.status = 'OFFERED' ORDER BY waitlist.offer_expire_time ASC, waitlist.id ASC

SELECT waitlist.id, waitlist.patient_id, COALESCE(patient.real_name, account.name, account.username) AS patient_name, account.username, account.phone, waitlist.status, waitlist.created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY waitlist.created_at ASC, waitlist.id ASC) AS queue_position FROM appointment_waitlist waitlist INNER JOIN patient ON patient.id = waitlist.patient_id INNER JOIN sys_user account ON account.id = patient.user_id WHERE waitlist.schedule_slot_id = #{scheduleSlotId} AND waitlist.status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY waitlist.created_at ASC, waitlist.id ASC
